blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `sdk.store.cart` set of methods used to send requests to Medusa's Store API routes.
Related guides: [How to implement carts in the storefront](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/cart).

This method creates a cart. It sends a request to the [Create Cart](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#carts\_postcarts)
API route.

Related guide: [How to create a cart in the storefront](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/cart/create).

types.name: body
types.description: The details of the cart to create.

children.name: region_id
children.description:
The ID of the region that the cart is created in.
If not provided, the default region of the store is used.
If the store doesn't have a default region, an error is thrown.

children.name: shipping_address
children.description: The cart's shipping address.

children.name: first_name
children.description: The first name of the address.

children.name: last_name
children.description: The last name of the address.

children.name: phone
children.description: The phone number of the address.

children.name: company
children.description: The company of the address.

children.name: address_1
children.description: The first address line of the address.

children.name: address_2
children.description: The second address line of the address.

children.name: city
children.description: The city of the address.

children.name: country_code
children.description: The country code of the address.

children.name: province
children.description: The lower-case [ISO 3166-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO\_3166-2) province/state of the address.

children.name: postal_code
children.description: The postal code of the address.
